environment: Linux; existing ARM and ARM-MLKEM shelves; no shelf rebuilt
evidence_boundary: Recorded warm source execution under the unchanged upstream premises and instruction semantics. Independent publication, ABI frame, alignment and source-to-object assembler audits are outside this record.
runtime_identity_note: Receipt client revision is unknown and non-authoritative. Commit identities and controller hashes are independently checked from clean frozen runtime worktrees. Retained-basis backend identities are compared against those hashes.
external_source_distribution: External sources, objects, raw transcripts, original receipts, configuration, memory images and machine paths remain outside the public repository.

factoring.change: The original prefix becomes a recorded project basis; the exact remaining suffix gains one literal needs declaration for that basis. No original premise, proof, frame or instruction bytes are edited.

control_definitions.equivalence_computed_goal_audit: The admitted equivalence theorem is checked for empty hypotheses and alpha-equivalence to the original computed goal, then proved again with ACCEPT_TAC as an audit alias.
control_definitions.wrong_sum_control: The literal unoptimized correctness conclusion replaces the result for the two input points with the result for the first input twice; ACCEPT_TAC is offered the original theorem. Premises and frame are preserved.
control_definitions.repaired_sum_control: The exact original literal unoptimized correctness quotation is restored and ACCEPT_TAC is offered the original theorem.
control_definitions.wrong_final_postcondition_control: The complete original factored leaf changes one byte in the optimized correctness result, replacing the second input point with the first. Premises, frame, tactics and the other four leaf targets remain unchanged.

timing_scope: Individual evaluation times collected alongside concurrent proof work; not a controlled profile comparison. Preparation and each fresh-child leaf are separate costs. admission_wait_seconds is receipt-reported admission wait and can omit earlier project-basis lock waiting; evaluation plus this field does not establish end-to-end wall time. This source split retains expensive exact-step and safety proofs in the leaf; a warm basis does not make the complete P256 leaf subsecond.
